description: This Java class defines the 'Product' entity within the catalog domain, incorporating database mappings via JPA annotations. It models product attributes like SKU, name, description, activity status, manufacturer, categories, and timestamps, including lifecycle callbacks for creation and update timestamps.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Entity class representing a product in the catalog with JPA annotations for ORM mapping and lifecycle callbacks to manage timestamps.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Sets creation and update timestamps before persisting a new Product entity.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Updates the 'updatedAt' timestamp before updating the Product entity.
